# `grid`

Helper: `grid(cols, ...kids)`, `grid({ cols, colsn, g }, ...)`, `split(main, aside)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `Workspace` (split / cards layout) or plain grid · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

CSS grid container.

## Variants

- `cols` number or template
- `colsn` template at 390
- `split(main, aside)`: main column 1.65fr, aside 1fr (min 300)

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

space scale, layout-aside-w

## Do

- Use `split` for a main area and a side card
- Four or more equal columns become two at 390

## Don't

- Do not use a grid for a list of rows (list or table)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Columns as given.

## Mobile (390)

One column unless `colsn` says otherwise (two for 4+ equal columns).

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Container. `cols`: number (equal columns), CSS template (`'minmax(0,1.65fr) minmax(300px,1fr)'`) ; `colsn` = template at 390 (default one column, two for 4+ equal columns)
